title: Free iStat Menus Alternative for macOS | Better Resource Monitor
description: Free, open-source iStat Menus alternative for macOS. Compare privacy, App Store access, resource use, and CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network monitoring.
heading: Better Resource Monitor vs iStat Menus for macOS
intro: If you are searching for an iStat Menus alternative, this is what to compare first. iStat Menus is a deep toolkit for power users. Better Resource Monitor is the lightweight menu bar monitor for people who just want clean CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network visibility, all day, with less setup and lower overhead.

sections.heading: Who should consider switching
sections.body: If you open your menu bar monitor mainly for quick signal, not a full control panel, Better Resource Monitor may be the better fit. Use iStat Menus when you need rich fan, thermal, and sensor detail; use Better Resource Monitor when you need a focused daily dashboard, lower resource use, and a faster setup.

sections.heading: Which one fits better
sections.body: If you want a full system suite with extra sensors and controls, iStat Menus covers more ground. If you mostly want a clean way to keep an eye on your Mac during the day, Better Resource Monitor is the more focused option. It sticks to CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage instead of trying to become a control panel for everything.

sections.heading: Migration with less friction
sections.body: You can start with Better Resource Monitor while keeping your current workflow intact. Download it from [the Mac App Store]({{appStoreUrl}}) or [GitHub releases]({{githubUrl}}/releases), enable the menu bar metrics you need, and compare against [Stats]({{vsStatsUrl}}) and [Eul]({{vsEulUrl}}) for adjacent alternatives.

sections.heading: Why Better Resource Monitor stays lighter
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor uses under 0.1% CPU on Apple Silicon and around 15 MB of memory. That lower overhead comes from keeping the feature set tighter and skipping the always-on sensor polling that heavier monitoring apps rely on. It is built to stay open all day without feeling like one more thing your Mac has to carry.

sections.heading: Easy to install, easy to trust
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor installs like a normal Mac app and is available on the Mac App Store with full features. No admin-password step, no root helper, no private APIs. Most people will not choose an app because of those details alone, but they do make the experience simpler and easier to trust.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor makes zero network requests. No analytics, no telemetry. Everything stays on your machine. If you want a monitor that quietly does its job and keeps to itself, that part is straightforward.

cta: If you need a full sensor suite, iStat Menus is likely the better choice. If you want a focused, lighter monitor, use [Better Resource Monitor on the Mac App Store]({{appStoreUrl}}), then compare [Stats]({{vsStatsUrl}}) and [Eul]({{vsEulUrl}}) to confirm your migration path.
